sentences.en: The grassroots organizing I had done and building our advocacy organization came in handy to build our public health campaigns.
sentences.zh: 我以前做过的基层动员以及建立我们的倡导组织的经验，在开展我们的公共卫生运动时派上了用场。

sentences.en: Like all of the clinical medicine work, of course, came in handy.
sentences.zh: 当然，所有的临床医学工作经验也都派上了用场。

sentences.en: My basic research background came in handy.
sentences.zh: 我的基础研究背景也派上了用场。

sentences.en: So it was a funny way.
sentences.zh: 所以这挺有意思的。

sentences.en: It was that job that brought together all of these crazy disparate parts of my experience.
sentences.zh: 正是那份工作，将我所有这些疯狂且迥异的经历碎片完美地结合在了一起。

sentences.en: And now, back to the show.
sentences.zh: 现在，言归正传。

sentences.en: Let me ask you something because, you know, I have a bunch of really depressing questions to ask you.
sentences.zh: 我问你个事，因为，你知道，我有一堆非常压抑的问题想问你。

sentences.en: So we'll get to those in a minute.
sentences.zh: 我们一会儿就聊到那些。

sentences.en: Greg can't wait.
sentences.zh: 格雷格已经迫不及待了。

sentences.en: But what is the difference between you?
sentences.zh: 但你们两个有什么区别？

sentences.en: Warn our listeners so they can go fix themselves a beverage.
sentences.zh: 提醒一下我们的听众，好让他们去给自己倒杯喝的。

sentences.en: So what about, what's the difference between you and Fauci?
sentences.zh: 那么，你和福奇之间有什么区别？

sentences.en: Because Fauci gets all the airtime.
sentences.zh: 因为福奇占用了所有的出镜时间。

sentences.en: And he seems to be the voice of, has been the voice of this pandemic and all that's been going on with it.
sentences.zh: 而且他似乎一直是——过去一直是——这场大流行以及随之发生的一切的代言人。

sentences.en: When it's you, that probably is, just speaking of job titles, above him, correct?
sentences.zh: 当是你的时候，从职位名称上来说，可能确实在他之上，对吧？

sentences.en: And having to implement all these things.
sentences.zh: 而且还得负责落实所有这些事情。

sentences.en: Well, there are different institutions, first of all.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，有不同的机构。

sentences.en: Oh, I didn't know.
sentences.zh: 哦，我不知道。

sentences.en: See, I don't know this.
sentences.zh: 你看，我不太了解这个。

sentences.en: Yeah, Fauci's at the National Institute of Health, right?
sentences.zh: 对啊，福奇在国家卫生研究院，对吧？

sentences.en: That broadband connection is really working for you.
sentences.zh: 你那个宽带连接可真给力啊。

sentences.en: I'm not even, you saw, I'm not even looking at that.
sentences.zh: 我甚至都没，你看，我连看都没看那个。

sentences.en: I mean, I just happen to pay attention to stuff and I have to be what they call naturally smart.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我只是碰巧关注一些事情，而且我必须得具备他们所说的那种天生聪明。

sentences.en: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: 请讲。

sentences.en: No, but I am, I am naturally stupid.
sentences.zh: 不，不过我是，我天生就很笨。

sentences.en: But truly, I didn't know where, see, I don't know how that works.
sentences.zh: 但说真的，我以前不知道在哪里，你看，我不知道那个是怎么运作的。

sentences.en: Like, isn't the Surgeon General the top, top, like that's the guy who runs the whole ship?
sentences.zh: 比如，卫生局长难道不是最高层吗？就像那是掌管整个大局的人？

sentences.en: Well, so it's a good question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: So, and, and Tony Fauci is, is an extraordinary guy.
sentences.zh: 所以，而且，托尼·福奇是个非常了不起的人。

sentences.en: He's a, he's a friend of mine from before we worked together when I was first SG, first time around.
sentences.zh: 他是我在我第一次担任卫生局长、我们共事之前就认识的老朋友了。

sentences.en: And we work really closely now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在合作得非常紧密。

sentences.en: So there are a number of people actually who, who sort of work as part of what is, I think about a medical leadership team.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上有许多人，他们某种程度上构成了我所理解的医疗领导团队的一部分。

sentences.en: Um, and they sort of work in, in parallel, but also collaboratively.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们既可以说是并行工作，但同时也相互协作。

sentences.en: One is, uh, Tony Fauci, who's at the NIH and runs the National Institute for Allergy and Infectious Disease.
sentences.zh: 一个是，呃，托尼·福奇，他在国立卫生研究院，负责国家过敏症和传染病研究所。

sentences.en: Uh, he's been a leader really since HIV on every major infectious disease outbreak we've had.
sentences.zh: 呃，从艾滋病时期开始，在我们经历的每一次重大传染病疫情中，他实际上一直是位领导者。

sentences.en: Uh, the other is the CDC director.
sentences.zh: 呃，另一个是疾控中心主任。

sentences.en: Uh, the other is myself, you know, a Surgeon General.
sentences.zh: 呃，另一个就是我自己，你知道，作为卫生局长。

sentences.en: And we all have sort of different lanes.
sentences.zh: 我们都有各自不同的职责分工。

sentences.en: And then there are a few others as well.
sentences.zh: 然后还有其他几位。

sentences.en: We all have different lanes that we sort of occupy.
sentences.zh: 我们都有各自负责的不同领域。

sentences.en: So the CDC is putting out, uh, actual guidance, you know, based on the epidemiological research that they are conducting.
sentences.zh: 所以疾控中心正在发布，呃，实际的指导方针，你知道的，这是基于他们正在进行的流行病学研究。

sentences.en: Uh, and data they're gathering.
sentences.zh: 呃，以及他们收集的数据。

sentences.en: So Dr. Fauci and his team are focused a lot on research and sort of basic science questions around the vaccine, around some of the therapies or treatments that you can get,
sentences.zh: 所以福奇博士和他的团队主要专注于围绕疫苗的研究和一些基础科学问题，以及你可以获得的某些疗法或治疗方法，

sentences.en: oral treatments and others.
sentences.zh: 口服疗法和其他疗法。

sentences.en: Myself, I focus a lot on everything from mobilizing our commission corps to respond and support localities and states to doing a lot of public communications.
sentences.zh: 而我本人，则把大量精力放在各个方面，从动员我们的军医部队去响应和支援地方和州，到开展大量的公众沟通。

sentences.en: So we, we do a lot of shared work together when it comes to decision-making and we certainly split up a lot of the communications work.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在决策时会做很多共同的工作，而且我们当然也分担了很大一部分沟通工作。

sentences.en: And actually, frankly, I'm grateful for that because this is like too big and too complicated a crisis to like for one person to try to figure out entirely on their own.
sentences.zh: 而且说实话，其实我很感激这一点，因为这场危机太宏大、太复杂了，单靠一个人根本无法完全搞定。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's what I was going to ask you about.
sentences.zh: 对，这正是我要问你的。

sentences.en: Was it the, the rollout of all the, uh, the vaccines, all those,
sentences.zh: 是不是关于，呃，所有这些疫苗的分发，所有那些，

sentences.en: all the shots you guys had to move across the country and make sure that they were in all the CVSs and Walgreens and all that stuff.
sentences.zh: 你们必须把所有这些注射剂运送到全国各地，确保它们送到所有的CVS、沃尔格林以及诸如此类的地方。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm sure you didn't get into the, the weeds, weeds, weeds on that,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我确信你不会去管那些极其繁琐的细节，

sentences.en: but I'm sure you were privy to some of those emails and the apparatus that you guys had to prop up in a week to try to get it out there and catch up for all of the horrifically wasted time.
sentences.zh: 但我确信你一定了解其中一些邮件，以及你们为了赶上进度、弥补那些被可怕浪费的时间，而在短短一周内搭建起来的那个运作机制。

sentences.en: Um, was that an immense thing to oversee, to witness, to affect, uh, what, how I'm sure you'll be humble and say that you, you left it up to a lot of, a lot of other folks.
sentences.zh: 嗯，监督、见证、影响这一切，这是一项巨大的任务吗？呃，我知道你肯定会很谦虚地说，你把这些都交给了许多其他人去处理。

sentences.en: But, uh, that must've been overwhelming to, uh, to accomplish and which you guys did remarkably well.
sentences.zh: 但是，呃，要完成这项任务一定压力巨大，而你们完成得非常出色。

sentences.en: Well, that's kind of you, Jason.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你太客气了，杰森。

sentences.en: I mean, you're right that the logistics are just, I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你说得对，后勤工作简直，我是说，

sentences.en: it's absolutely extraordinary how complicated they are because even if you just take something as simple as getting vaccines to a pharmacy, right?
sentences.zh: 其复杂程度绝对非同寻常，因为即使你只拿一件像把疫苗送到药店这样简单的事情来说，对吧？

sentences.en: There are different types of vaccines.
sentences.zh: 有不同类型的疫苗。

sentences.en: They require different storages.
sentences.zh: 它们需要不同的储存条件。

sentences.en: They have different dosages.
sentences.zh: 它们的剂量也不同。

sentences.en: Um, you, in some cases have to advise patients differently on them.
sentences.zh: 呃，在某些情况下，你必须就此向患者提供不同的建议。

sentences.en: Cause some are two doses, some are only one dose.
sentences.zh: 因为有些需要打两剂，有些只需要打一剂。

sentences.en: It comes to getting them into doctor's offices.
sentences.zh: 如果说到把它们送到医生诊所去。

sentences.en: That's a whole other kettle of fish, right?
sentences.zh: 那完全是另一码事了，对吧？

sentences.en: Cause doctor's offices have very different setups than pharmacies.
sentences.zh: 因为医务所的设备和药房有很大不同。

sentences.en: They don't necessarily have big, deep, you know, deep freeze, you know, like, you know, apparatus like store, like in the Pfizer vaccine, which is required early on.
sentences.zh: 它们不一定有那种大型的、深层的冷冻设备，你知道的，就像辉瑞疫苗早期要求的那种装置。

sentences.en: Uh, so it's incredibly complicated and not to mention that each state often wants to approach it a bit differently, how they distribute the vaccines,
sentences.zh: 呃，所以这极其复杂，更不用说每个州往往都希望在疫苗分发方式上采取略有不同的方法，

sentences.en: how much they lean in or lean out, whether they want to do big, large mass vaccination events or a whole bunch of mobile units.
sentences.zh: 在多大程度上投入或退缩，是想举办大型的群体免疫接种活动，还是搞一大堆流动接种小分队。

sentences.en: So what we had to do early on as a, as a federal government is really coordinate and support them with everything from funds to logistics, to personnel, uh, and we had,
sentences.zh: 所以我们早期作为联邦政府必须做的事情，就是真正地进行统筹协调，并在资金、后勤、人员等方方面面支持他们，呃，而且我们拥有，

sentences.en: and with metrics.
sentences.zh: 并且还有指标体系。

sentences.en: So we had to be able to quickly measure like how we're doing in each state.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要能够快速衡量我们在每个州的进展情况。

sentences.en: Cause you don't want to wait three months to figure out something's not going well, right?
sentences.zh: 因为你可不想等上三个月才发现有些事情进展不顺利，对吧？

sentences.en: We need to know it ASAP so you can fix it.
sentences.zh: 我们需要尽快了解情况，以便能够解决问题。

sentences.en: So I'll say from our standpoint, like, you know, I was, while I was not like, you know, calling each of the CVSs and saying, Hey, you know, got the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 所以我会从我们的角度来说，你知道的，我虽然没有，你知道的，去给每一家CVS打电话说，嘿，你知道的，拿到疫苗了。

sentences.en: Um, we had thankfully a team, uh, sort of a COVID-19 team that had some really talented, capable people who were working on logistics.
sentences.zh: 嗯，谢天谢地，我们有一个团队，呃，有点像是一个新冠肺炎团队，里面有一些真正才华横溢、能力出众的人在负责后勤工作。

sentences.en: And every morning we would talk and talk through, uh, everything from what's the latest on the science, what's the latest on logistics and distribution on public education efforts.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨我们都会开会讨论，呃，从科学方面的最新进展，到后勤和分发的最新情况，再到公众教育工作的最新动态，无所不谈。

sentences.en: Uh, and we would go through all of that because, you know, every day so much happened and so much.
sentences.zh: 呃，我们会把这些全部过一遍，因为，你知道的，每天发生的事情实在是太多了。

sentences.en: And I would, I would imagine that with what you give it without getting political, but we, given the last administration, um,
sentences.zh: 而且我想象着，抛开政治不谈，但是我们，考虑到上一届政府，嗯，

sentences.en: you having already been the surgeon general and watching what was happening slash not happening with that administration.
sentences.zh: 你当时已经担任过外科医生总监，并且目睹了那届政府对疫情的种种应对，或者说毫无作为。

sentences.en: Did you, did you hit redial on that phone number and say, Hey guys, if you're still interested, I'd still love to serve again.
sentences.zh: 你有没有，你有没有重新拨打那个电话号码说，嘿，伙计们，如果你们还感兴趣的话，我还是很乐意再次为之效劳的。

sentences.en: Cause I see that there's, there's a bit of a hole there.
sentences.zh: 因为我看到那里似乎，似乎存在一些漏洞。

sentences.en: Or, uh, was it, were you, or did they call you?
sentences.zh: 还是说，呃，是这样吗，或者他们给你打电话了？

sentences.en: Were you super excited about that?
sentences.zh: 你对此感到超级兴奋吗？

sentences.en: That must've just been, uh, a really fraught time for you observing and, and being on the sideline and wanting to get back in there.
sentences.zh: 那对你来说一定是一个，呃，非常焦灼的时期，只能在一旁观察，被晾在局外，却又渴望重新加入进去。

sentences.en: It was a really, um, it's complicated and frustrating year in 2020 for me, because, um, you know, when you've been a part of pandemic responses before and you see, uh, you know,
sentences.zh: 对我来说，2020年确实是一个非常，嗯，复杂且沮丧的年份，因为，嗯，你知道的，当你以前参与过大流行病的应对，并且你看到，呃，你知道的，

sentences.en: the next pandemic come up, like you just, and this is not a political statement, it's just a practical statement.
sentences.zh: 下一次大流行病爆发时，你就会，这并不是什么政治表态，这只是一个切合实际的表态。

sentences.en: You want to help, you know, you want to be involved, you want to serve in whatever way you can.
sentences.zh: 你想去帮忙，你知道的，你想参与其中，想以你所能的任何方式去服务。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: How frustrating is it when, when what you want to do that you're, you're involved in public health and serving and,
sentences.zh: 当你想做的事情是投身于公共卫生事业、去服务、去，

sentences.en: and trying and looking out for the best interests of the public health.
sentences.zh: 并且努力照顾好公众健康的最佳利益时，这种心情有多让人沮丧？

sentences.en: And anytime politics, and again, all of us want to stay out of politics.
sentences.zh: 而每当政治介入时——再说一次，我们所有人都想远离政治。

sentences.en: When anytime somebody is sort of inserts that, it's like, no, no, no, I'm not here to serve a political agenda.
sentences.zh: 每当有人把政治因素掺杂进来的时候，就会让人觉得，不，不，不，我来这里不是为了服务什么政治议程。

sentences.en: I am.
sentences.zh: 我是来……

sentences.en: And you must, you must feel going crazy.
sentences.zh: 你肯定会觉得自己快要疯了。

sentences.en: You have to keep repeating that in different ways of explaining to people, I'm not here to sell you anything.
sentences.zh: 你不得不一遍又一遍地用各种不同的方式向人们解释，我不是来向你们推销任何东西的。

sentences.en: Just save lives.
sentences.zh: 我只是想拯救生命。

sentences.en: Other than I'm trying to make you feel better.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，我只是想让你们感觉好一点。

sentences.en: And I want everybody to be healthy.
sentences.zh: 我希望每个人都健健康康的。

sentences.en: Hey, that's it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，就这么简单。

sentences.en: And there's a blueprint that we spent time working on and left behind and then it gets ignored.
sentences.zh: 我们花时间制定并留下一套蓝图，结果却被无视了。

sentences.en: And then, so you must've been like, please call, please call, please call.
sentences.zh: 所以当时你心里一定在想，快打电话来，快打电话来，快打电话来。

sentences.en: And then they did.
sentences.zh: 然后他们真的打了。

sentences.en: Well, so this is actually what, what happened is, um, in, or very early in the pandemic, early in 2020, um, I, you know, I had, I had worked a bit with, um,
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以实际情况是，呃，在，或者说在大流行之初，2020年初的时候，呃，我，你知道的，我曾跟，呃，

sentences.en: then vice president Biden.
sentences.zh: 时任副总统的拜登一起工作过。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: In the, uh, Obama administration, but he and his team had, had reached out, uh, to see if I could help just provide some support and advice, uh, during the early stages of COVID.
sentences.zh: 在呃奥巴马政府期间，但他和他的团队曾联系过我，呃，想看看我是否能在新冠疫情的早期阶段提供一些支持和建议。

sentences.en: Uh, you know, he, and, and so I did, you know, and my, my general philosophy was look, if, if a decision maker,
sentences.zh: 呃，你知道的，他，然后我就去了，你知道的，我的一般原则是，听着，如果一个决策者、

sentences.en: policy maker wants to understand more about a health related subject, as experts, we should help.
sentences.zh: 政策制定者想要更多地了解与健康相关的主题，作为专家，我们应该提供帮助。

sentences.en: Like that's our job.
sentences.zh: 就像那是我们的工作一样。

sentences.en: You know, we need to like, that's what we should do for the public intereSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们需要去这样做，这才是为了公众利益我们应该做的事。

sentences.en: But I also had known him from before and I knew that, um, you know, that, uh, you know, he's very thoughtful about science expertise, like letting, you know,
sentences.zh: 但我也以前就认识他，我知道，呃，你知道的，呃，他对科学专业知识非常重视，比如让，你知道的，

sentences.en: really leading with that first and foremoSt.
sentences.zh: 真正把科学放在首要位置。

sentences.en: And so I was like, yeah, you know, happy, happy to help.
sentences.zh: 所以当时我就想，好吧，你知道的，我很乐意，很乐意帮忙。

sentences.en: So what happened actually very in, starting in March of 2020 is, uh, his team asked me and, and one other, uh, colleague to start doing a series of daily briefings with him on,
sentences.zh: 所以实际上发生的事情是，从2020年3月开始，呃，他的团队邀请我和另一位呃同事开始与他进行一系列的每日简报会，内容关于，

sentences.en: on COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 关于新冠肺炎疫情。

sentences.en: And so it was a fascinating experience because, um, well, I had spent some time with him before I, it was, this was a whole different level of, of depth of engagement.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一次迷人的经历，因为，嗯，我之前和他共处过一段时间，但，这是一个完全不同层面的深入交流。

sentences.en: Cause we were doing these daily briefs.
sentences.zh: 因为我们在做这些每日简报。

sentences.en: The team would sometimes a lot, usually in the order of half an hour, uh, for us to talk to him about like the latest status of COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 团队有时会花很多时间，通常大约半小时左右，让我们向他汇报关于新冠肺炎的最新进展。

sentences.en: But it was very common that these briefings would go 60 minutes or even 90 minutes because he was asking such interesting, detailed questions.
sentences.zh: 但这些简报通常会持续60分钟甚至90分钟，因为他会提出如此有趣、详细的问题。

sentences.en: And, and a lot of times I didn't expect him to ask at that level of detail.
sentences.zh: 而且，很多时候我没想到他会问到这么细致的程度。

sentences.en: I mean, I was excited by it, but, but he really wanted to like get his arms around us, understand like, not just what's going on, but like, what do we need to do now?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我为此感到兴奋，但是，他真的很想全面掌握，不仅想了解发生了什么，还想知道我们现在需要做什么？

sentences.en: What do we need to be planning for in six months, 12 months?
sentences.zh: 我们需要为六个月、十二个月后规划什么？

sentences.en: Uh, how do we prevent this thing from happening a second time around?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们如何防止这种事情发生第二次？

sentences.en: Who is most impacted?
sentences.zh: 谁受到的影响最大？

sentences.en: We spent a lot of time, for example, talking about like the disparate impact of COVID-19 on black and brown communities and the impact, for example,
sentences.zh: 例如，我们花了很多时间讨论新冠肺炎对黑人和棕色人种社区的不同影响，以及比如...

sentences.en: the school closures we're having on increasing, for example, food insecurity among, for many kids.
sentences.zh: 学校关停对增加许多孩子的粮食不安全感所产生的影响。

sentences.en: Which is not, yeah, which has not been talked about enough, uh, in this country, frankly.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，这在，是的，这在这个国家讨论得还不够多。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And, and to your point, Will, what COVID has highlighted is that so many of the issues that we're now and have been reading about in the paper, food insecurity,
sentences.zh: 而且，正如你所说，威尔，新冠凸显了这样一个事实：现在我们在报纸上读到以及一直在关注的许多问题，比如粮食不安全、

sentences.en: disparities in health, mental health, the mental health crisis.
sentences.zh: 健康差距、心理健康、心理健康危机。

sentences.en: That we have, including among our young people.
sentences.zh: 我们所面临的危机，包括在年轻人当中。

sentences.en: A lot of these are worse now, but they predated the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 其中很多问题现在更严重了，但它们在大流行之前就已经存在了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, they were bad before.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它们以前就很糟糕。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, we just, we're not focusing enough attention, energy, and investment on that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们只是没有把足够的注意力、精力和投资放在那上面。

sentences.en: I want to talk to you about the mental health thing because, you know, and Project Starfish, because I want you to tell everybody what Project Starfish is.
sentences.zh: 我想跟你聊聊心理健康的事，因为，你知道，还有“海星计划”，因为我想让你告诉大家什么是“海星计划”。

sentences.en: It's really cool.
sentences.zh: 这真的很酷。

sentences.en: But the mental health, clearly, it seems like mental health is the next pandemic.
sentences.zh: 但心理健康，显然，心理健康似乎是下一场大流行。

sentences.en: There is a mass shooting almost every day.
sentences.zh: 几乎每天都会发生大规模枪击事件。

sentences.en: And it's almost based on somebody who has had a history of mental health issues.
sentences.zh: 而且这几乎都发生在有心理健康问题历史的人身上。

sentences.en: And it seems to be getting worse and worse and worse.
sentences.zh: 而且情况似乎越来越糟糕。

sentences.en: So talk a little bit about that and tell them what Project Starfish is.
sentences.zh: 所以请稍微谈谈这个，并告诉大家什么是“海星计划”。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, I'm glad you raised mental health.
sentences.zh: 好的，嗯，我很高兴你提出心理健康的话题。

sentences.en: I mean, this was a huge issue.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个巨大的问题。

sentences.en: We had record rates, really, of depression and anxiety in our country, particularly among young people.
sentences.zh: 在我国，抑郁症和焦虑症的发病率确实创了纪录，特别是在年轻人当中。

sentences.en: Incredibly high rates of suicide before COVID-19 came.
sentences.zh: 在新冠疫情到来之前，自杀率就高得惊人。

sentences.en: And then COVID hits.
sentences.zh: 然后新冠爆发了。

sentences.en: And just yesterday, I spent, you know, the day at a middle school or part of the day at a middle school talking to students about what their experience of the pandemic was like.
sentences.zh: 就在昨天，你知道，我在一所初中度过了整整一天或部分时间，与学生们交谈，了解他们经历大流行是什么样的感受。

sentences.en: And I can't tell you how many of them said that they just, that they felt cut off from friends, that they felt they didn't know how to really engage with the virtual learning.
sentences.zh: 我无法告诉你他们中有多少人说，他们只是觉得与朋友隔绝了，觉得不知道该如何真正参与虚拟学习。

sentences.en: And they felt like they were falling behind.
sentences.zh: 而且他们觉得自己正在落后。

sentences.en: Some of them found silver linings during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人在大流行期间发现了一线生机。

sentences.en: They found things that they got really excited to learn about on their own.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了自己非常乐意自主学习的东西。

sentences.en: And they were able to quarantine with family and, like, really deepen their relationship with them.
sentences.zh: 他们能够和家人一起隔离，并且，真正加深了与家人的关系。

sentences.en: But it was a real struggle for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 但对许多人来说，这是一场真正的挣扎。

sentences.en: So here are some thoughts on it.
sentences.zh: 所以这里有一些关于它的想法。

sentences.en: I think we have an opportunity now, like, as a country, to really rethink how we address mental health.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们现在有机会，作为国家，真正重新思考我们如何应对心理健康问题。

sentences.en: Not just from the standpoint of how do we prevent mental illness.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是从我们如何预防精神疾病的角度出发。

sentences.en: But how do we recognize that mental health and well-being is about more than just saying, okay, I don't have clinical depression.
sentences.zh: 而是如何认识到，心理健康和福祉不仅仅意味着“好吧，我没有临床抑郁症”。

sentences.en: I don't have a generalized anxiety disorder.
sentences.zh: “我没有广泛性焦虑障碍。”

sentences.en: That's, like, one half of the spectrum.
sentences.zh: 这只是光谱的一半。

sentences.en: The other half of the spectrum is one where we can be having pretty rotten days, you know, be operating in a funk, you know, with a pretty low level of emotional energy.
sentences.zh: 光谱的另一半是，我们可能会度过相当糟糕的日子，你知道，情绪低落，情感能量处于相当低的水平。

sentences.en: Or we can be operating at the top end of our scale, you know, really bringing our all to our work, to our family, to our community.
sentences.zh: 或者我们可以在状态的巅峰运行，你知道，真正为我们的工作、家庭、社区倾注全部心力。

sentences.en: And we never really talk about how to do that, how to train our kids and give them a foundation for enhancing their emotional health and well-being.
sentences.zh: 而我们从没有真正讨论过该如何做到这一点，如何培训我们的孩子，并为他们打好基础，以提升他们的心理健康与福祉。

sentences.en: And we've just got to see it as part and parcel of health.
sentences.zh: 我们必须将这一点视为健康不可或缺的一部分。

sentences.en: So, one of the things that we've been working on in our office is something we call Project Starfish.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们在办公室里一直致力于的一项工作叫做“海星计划”。

sentences.en: And the Starfish, you know, so many of you know, Starfish, it's an organism that regenerates, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，很多人都知道海星，海星是一种能够再生的生物，对吧？

sentences.en: And so, we think of this as an opportunity, this moment, as hard as it has been over the last 18 months, for us to think,
sentences.zh: 因此，我们将此视为一个机遇，正如过去18个月一样艰难的这段时期，让我们去思考，

sentences.en: how do we want to remake ourselves as a society into not just what we were in 2019, but something potentially even better?
sentences.zh: 我们希望如何将自己这个社会重新塑造，不仅是恢复到2019年的状态，而是可能变得更好？

sentences.en: A lot of people are thinking about this, you know, on their own.
sentences.zh: 很多人其实都在自己思考这个问题。

sentences.en: They're kind of having second thoughts maybe about the job that they have.
sentences.zh: 他们可能对现在的工作产生了一些别的想法。

sentences.en: Like, is that really the right job?
sentences.zh: 比如，这真的是一份合适的工作吗？

sentences.en: Or about maybe the balance they had with time with family and work.
sentences.zh: 或者是关于他们陪伴家人与工作之间的时间平衡。

sentences.en: Maybe they want more time with family.
sentences.zh: 也许他们想要更多陪伴家人的时间。

sentences.en: A lot of people have moved to be closer to family and friends because they realize this is not worth being far apart.
sentences.zh: 许多人已经搬家去离家人和朋友更近的地方，因为他们意识到离得太远根本不值得。

sentences.en: But if we don't take a real conscious approach to this and intentionally think, you know, about what kind of society we want to design post-pandemic,
sentences.zh: 但如果我们不采取真正有意识的方法，不去刻意思考，你知道的，我们希望在疫情后设计什么样的社会，

sentences.en: how do we want our workplaces to support mental health?
sentences.zh: 我们希望职场如何支持心理健康？

sentences.en: How do we think we should be giving kids a foundation in schools for mental health and well-being?
sentences.zh: 我们认为应该如何在学校为孩子的心理健康和福祉打下基础？

sentences.en: How do we think as a government we should be investing in prevention up front and in mental health rather than waiting, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们认为政府应该如何将资金投入到前期的预防和心理健康中，而不是等待，你知道的，

sentences.en: years for problems to arise and then trying to solve them?
sentences.zh: 等问题出现多年后才去试图解决？

sentences.en: If we don't do that now, I worry we will lose a window of opportunity to act and to fashion a stronger, more equitable, more resilient society.
sentences.zh: 如果我们现在不这样做，我担心我们会失去一个行动的窗口期，无法塑造一个更强大、更公平、更具韧性的社会。

sentences.en: Can I ask you, in your position, do you have the authority, if you wanted to, let's say, if you wanted to start a required subject in public schools, like there's, you know,
sentences.zh: 请问您，以您的职位，您是否有权这样做——假设您想这么做，比如说，如果您想在公立学校开设一门必修课，就像我们有，你知道的，

sentences.en: English, math, history, and you have to take mental wellness or whatever we would call it.
sentences.zh: 英语、数学、历史，而你必须修读心理健康或其他什么我们称之为它的课程。

sentences.en: Do you have the authority in your job position or is that sort of the head of education or if you – could you implement that unilaterally as a policy if you wanted to?
sentences.zh: 以您的工作职位，您拥有这样的权力吗？还是说这应该由教育主管来决定？如果您愿意的话，能否作为一项政策单方面推行？

sentences.en: It's a good question, Jason.
sentences.zh: 这是一个好问题，杰森。

sentences.en: The answer is no and because a lot of our policy in schools, education policy, is actually very decentralized.
sentences.zh: 答案是不能，因为我们的很多学校政策、教育政策实际上是非常分散的。

sentences.en: So it's under local control and that's why local school boards are often the ones that make decisions on things like curricula or on other subjects of what's focused on in school.
sentences.zh: 所以它受地方控制，这就是为什么地方学校董事会通常是决定课程或学校重点关注的其他科目等事情的主体。

sentences.en: But what we can do from our office, and we are actually working on an initiative right now around youth mental health,
sentences.zh: 但我们办公室能做的是——我们目前实际上正在围绕青年心理健康开展一项倡议——

sentences.en: is we can build a compelling blueprint that we can work with the federal government on supporting but work with states and localities on implementing so that schools do have,
sentences.zh: 我们可以构建一个引人注目的蓝图，我们可以与联邦政府合作提供支持，并与各州和地方合作落实，以便学校确实拥有，

sentences.en: you know, a sense of how to create this foundation.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，关于如何创造这个基础的理念。

sentences.en: Because here's the thing, Jason, if you talk to parents around the country, increasingly more and more of them recognize that there's a mental health crisis, you know,
sentences.zh: 因为情况是这样的，杰森，如果你和全国各地的父母交流，越来越多的人认识到存在着一场心理健康危机，你知道的，

sentences.en: among youth in this country, right?
sentences.zh: 在这个国家的年轻人当中，对吧？

sentences.en: And so they have questions like, is it because of social media?
sentences.zh: 所以他们会问这样的问题：这是因为社交媒体吗？

sentences.en: Is it because of something else?
sentences.zh: 是因为别的原因吗？

sentences.en: Is it like, you know, whatever the factor sociological may be?
sentences.zh: 就像是，你知道的，无论社会学方面的因素可能是什么？

sentences.en: It might be because of this podcast, but yeah.
sentences.zh: 也许是因为这个播客，但是吧。

sentences.en: You think it's having an effect.
sentences.zh: 你觉得它产生了影响。

sentences.en: Some damage is coming from this.
sentences.zh: 这带来了一些损害。

sentences.en: Social media, can we just get rid of it altogether?
sentences.zh: 社交媒体，我们能彻底摆脱它吗？

sentences.en: I think it's the scourge of humanity.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是人类的祸害。

sentences.en: And I think it's –
sentences.zh: 而且我认为——

sentences.en: I agree.
sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.en: It's so big, though.
sentences.zh: 不过它太庞大了。

sentences.en: It's destroying –
sentences.zh: 它正在摧毁——

sentences.en: Hey, granddad.
sentences.zh: 嘿，老爷爷。

sentences.en: Destroying us.
sentences.zh: 摧毁我们。

sentences.en: And you want people to stay off your yard too?
sentences.zh: 你还想赶走草坪上的人吗？

sentences.en: Well, no, I – look, I've always wanted to know, and I want to – because I'm never going to have this chance to talk to somebody, a health official such as yourself, Admiral.
sentences.zh: 不，我——听着，我一直想知道，我想——因为我绝不会有这样的机会与像您这样的一位卫生官员对话，海军准将。

sentences.en: So I've been – I've switched it up, and I now will eat a salad, and then I'll work out like an hour later, and I find that that – flipping that,
sentences.zh: 所以我一直在——我改变了方式，现在我会先吃沙拉，然后大约一小时后再去健身，我发现那——颠倒过来，

sentences.en: I'm burning all those calories that I know.
sentences.zh: 我正在燃烧我知道的所有那些卡路里。

sentences.en: Anyway, just so – yeah, we're probably –
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，只是为了——是的，我们可能——

sentences.en: Are you out of your mind?
sentences.zh: 你疯了吗？

sentences.en: Don't cut me off.
sentences.zh: 别打断我。

sentences.en: This is important stuff, and people want to know because, you know –
sentences.zh: 这很重要，大家都很想知道，因为，你知道——

sentences.en: You want to know workout before eating.
sentences.zh: 你想知道饭前还是饭后锻炼。

sentences.en: He talked about remaking your – I'm remaking myself, and it's incredible.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了重塑你的——我在重塑自我，这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: I want to know one thing.
sentences.zh: 我只想知道一件事。

sentences.en: One thing, Dr. Murthy, because you were talking about – you touched on the mental health, which leads me to the next thing, which is loneliness.
sentences.zh: 就一件事，莫西博士，因为你刚才谈到了——你提到了心理健康，这让我想到下一个问题，也就是孤独感。

sentences.en: I know you've done a ton of research on loneliness, which I think is fascinating.
sentences.zh: 我知道你对孤独感做过大量研究，我觉得这非常迷人。

sentences.en: Like, who researches loneliness?
sentences.zh: 比如，谁会去研究孤独感呢？

sentences.en: And I want to – I think it's such a common fear, especially as one gets older, and a lot of people are embarrassed to admit it, right?
sentences.zh: 我想——我觉得这是一种非常普遍的恐惧，尤其是随着人年龄的增长，很多人都不好意思承认，对吧？

sentences.en: Admit that that's a fear.
sentences.zh: 承认这是一种恐惧。

sentences.en: And I know it's one of mine, and I – you know, I think everybody thinks about it.
sentences.zh: 我知道这也是我的恐惧之一，而且——你知道的，我觉得每个人都会考虑到这一点。

sentences.en: Oh, we couldn't tell, because you just spent 10 minutes on this question.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们完全看不出来，因为你刚才在这个问题上花了10分钟。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Anyway, wait, where are you all going?
sentences.zh: 总之，等等，你们都去哪儿了？

sentences.en: Where are you going?
sentences.zh: 你们去哪儿？

sentences.en: Was my question too long?
sentences.zh: 我的问题太长了吗？

sentences.en: Where are you going?
sentences.zh: 你们去哪儿？

sentences.en: I think I see them back in a way – I don't know what that's all about.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我隐约看到他们回来了——我不知道这到底是怎么回事。

sentences.en: But yeah, you know, it's really interesting.
sentences.zh: 不过是的，你知道，这真的很有趣。

sentences.en: I totally didn't think I was going to discuss, think about, research, or work on that issue of loneliness when I started my term as Surgeon General.
sentences.zh: 当我开始担任美国外科医生总长时，我完全没想到我会去讨论、思考、研究或处理孤独感这个问题。

sentences.en: But you know what happened to me is I spent a lot of time talking to people around the country.
sentences.zh: 但你知道我经历了什么吗？我花了很多时间与全国各地的人交流。

sentences.en: And what they would say to me are things like, you know, I feel like I've got to handle all of these struggles in my life by myself.
sentences.zh: 他们对我说的话通常是这样的，你知道的，我感觉生活中的所有这些挣扎都只能靠自己去面对。

sentences.en: Or I feel if I disappear tomorrow, nobody would even notice.
sentences.zh: 或者我觉得如果我明天消失了，根本没有人会注意到。

sentences.en: Or I walk around just feeling totally invisible.
sentences.zh: 或者我走在路上，觉得自己完全是个透明人。

sentences.en: And this wasn't just, you know, people who are living alone at the end stages of their life who were saying this.
sentences.zh: 而且说这话的人不仅仅是那些独自生活在生命晚期的独居老人。

sentences.en: I'm talking about college kids on campuses surrounded by thousands of other kids who were saying this.
sentences.zh: 我说的是那些身处大学校园、身边环绕着成千上万同龄人却这样说的大学生。

sentences.en: I'm talking about people who go to work every day in busy office settings surrounded by lots of people who were saying this.
sentences.zh: 我说的是那些每天去繁忙的办公室上班、身边围着许多人却这样说的职场人士。

sentences.en: Yeah, I've heard – because, Sean, you were saying that you had gone – because of having to wear a mask, you went to Gelson's and nobody recognized you.
sentences.zh: 是的，我听说过——因为，肖恩，你曾说过你去了——因为不得不戴着口罩，你去了吉尔森超市，结果没有人认出你。

sentences.en: And you felt like just – you were invisible for the first time.
sentences.zh: 你觉得自己仿佛——生平第一次变成了隐形人。

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then at the checkout, I pulled my mask down and I felt better about myself.
sentences.zh: 然后在结账时，我把口罩拉下来，感觉自己好多了。

sentences.en: Yeah, and you got back into your Tesla and you said to Scotty, I just feel so invisible.
sentences.zh: 对，然后你坐回你的特斯拉，对斯科蒂说，我感觉自己太隐形了。

sentences.en: Invisible.
sentences.zh: 隐形。

sentences.en: Admiral, tell me – what is – you know so much about how to keep your body right and to stay healthy.
sentences.zh: 将军，告诉我——什么是——你对如何保持身体健康、维持健康体魄了解那么多。

sentences.en: What is the least healthy thing you do to yourself that you probably should not tell America but you're going to on the SmartList podcast?
sentences.zh: 你做过对身体最不健康的一件事是什么？你可能不应该告诉全美民众，但你却要在“智能清单”播客里说出来？

sentences.en: What's your guilty damage?
sentences.zh: 你有什么会产生罪恶感的放纵习惯？

sentences.en: Is it sugar?
sentences.zh: 是糖吗？

sentences.en: Is it salt?
sentences.zh: 是盐吗？

sentences.en: Or you smoke three packs a day?
sentences.zh: 还是你一天抽三包烟？

sentences.en: That's what it is, right?
sentences.zh: 就是这个，对吧？

sentences.en: No, no, I'm not going to – I don't smoke three packs a day.
sentences.zh: 不，不，我不会——我没有一天抽三包烟。

sentences.en: But here's where I am actually really falling short.
sentences.zh: 但接下来才是我真正做得不够好的地方。

sentences.zh: 因为他们会在这些东西上看到它。

sentences.en: Right, of course.
sentences.zh: 对，当然。

sentences.en: Some people think I spent all my days stamping boxes of cigarettes with warnings, but that is not the case.
sentences.zh: 有些人以为我整天都在香烟盒上盖警告印章，但事实并非如此。

sentences.zh: 那你到底在做什么不健康的事？

sentences.en: So what I'm doing that sets – where I'm falling short is around sleep, right?
sentences.zh: 我做得不够好、有所欠缺的地方在于睡眠，对吧？

sentences.en: So what I really should be doing is I should be sleeping somewhere around eight hours a night.
sentences.zh: 所以，我真正应该做的，是每晚大概睡八个小时左右。

sentences.en: Seven to nine is what most people need.
sentences.zh: 大多数人需要七到九个小时。

sentences.en: I should be sleeping at a consistent time each night, and I should be keeping distractions away from me when I sleep, like phones, all the kinds of stuff.
sentences.zh: 我每晚应该在固定的时间睡觉，而且睡觉时应该远离干扰，比如手机之类的各种东西。

sentences.en: Sleep hygiene.
sentences.zh: 睡眠卫生。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Sleep hygiene.
sentences.zh: 睡眠卫生。

sentences.en: And that's something I want to do, but I've struggled with that.
sentences.zh: 这也是我想做的事，但我在这方面一直很挣扎。

sentences.en: Like I don't – I haven't prioritized and executed on getting to bed.
sentences.zh: 比如我——我一直没有把上床睡觉当作优先事项并去执行。

sentences.en: And is that because of work?
sentences.zh: 那是工作的原因吗？

sentences.en: Is that because of family?
sentences.zh: 是家庭的原因吗？

sentences.en: Is that because of the balance of the two, or you've always been wired that way?
sentences.zh: 是因为这两者的平衡，还是你一直以来就是这种作息？

sentences.en: It's work.
sentences.zh: 是工作。

sentences.zh: 他得开着手机，好让拜登随时给他发短信，万一他——而且他会给你发一堆滑板小猫的表情包，对吧？

sentences.en: And that's keeping you up late, and it's pissing you off.
sentences.zh: 而这让你熬夜到很晚，也惹恼了你。

sentences.en: You've got to just go on do not disturb on the –
sentences.zh: 你只需要把——设置成免打扰就行了

sentences.en: I was like, oh, I love this one.

sentences.zh: 目前的情况绝对不是这样的。

sentences.zh: 但实际上是几个原因造成的。

sentences.en: I mean, one is like it's – I've never been somebody who's been consistent about sleep across my life.
sentences.zh: 我是说，其一是——我这辈子从来都不是一个作息规律的人。

sentences.en: So it's been kind of a lifelong struggle.
sentences.zh: 所以这算是我一生的挣扎。

sentences.en: There we go.

sentences.en: So the second thing is I generally have operated as a night owl most of my life, but I have to get up very early, so that doesn't make for a good combination.
sentences.zh: 所以第二点是，我这辈子大部分时间基本上都是个夜猫子，但我又得起得很早，所以这并不是个好组合。

sentences.en: And the third is I have kids, right?
sentences.zh: 第三点是我有孩子，对吧？

sentences.en: So I have small kids, and they're three and a half and five.
sentences.zh: 我有幼儿，他们一个三岁半，一个五岁。

sentences.en: And my five-year-old son, he just refuses to sleep if I'm not actually next to him in the bed.
sentences.zh: 我五岁的儿子，如果我不在床上陪着他，他根本拒绝睡觉。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Like he threatens to go on strike, all this kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 比如他威胁要罢工，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: So, you know, slightly embarrassing because I'm probably a bad parent for this, but we just let him sleep with me, and my daughter sleeps with my wife,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，这有点尴尬，因为我可能因此是个糟糕的家长，但我们只能让他跟我睡，我女儿跟我妻子睡，

sentences.en: and we somehow figure it out.
sentences.zh: 然后我们总能设法应付过去。

sentences.en: But half the night, he's like punching me, kicking me, just making sure I'm still there.
sentences.zh: 但在半夜里，他会捶我、踢我，只是为了确认我还在不在。

sentences.en: I know how to construct a pillow wall between me and my kids like no one's business.
sentences.zh: 我特别擅长在我和孩子之间用枕头垒出一堵墙，可以说是无人能及。

sentences.en: Because if anything touches me, I'm up.
sentences.zh: 因为只要有任何东西碰到我，我就会醒。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So I've got to create a little pillow wall there.
sentences.zh: 所以我得在那儿弄一堵小枕头墙。

sentences.en: I still, my sons are going to hate that I'm saying this out loud.
sentences.zh: 我还是——我儿子们要是听到我大声说出这些肯定会讨厌我的。

sentences.en: They're almost 13 next week and 11, and they still, at night, I have to lie with them in bed and put them to bed in that way until they fall asleep.
sentences.zh: 他们下周就快13岁和11岁了，到了晚上，我还是得躺在床上陪他们，用那种方式哄他们睡觉，直到他们睡着。

sentences.en: That's so great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And it's just, it's what we do for our kids.
sentences.zh: 这其实就是——这就是我们为孩子所做的事。

sentences.en: It's just the way it is.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: But I will say this, Admiral, and I'm sorry, I hate to pull rank on you, but.
sentences.zh: 但我要说的是，上将，对不起，我讨厌对你摆官架子，不过。

sentences.en: Nice, nice.
sentences.zh: 不错，不错。

sentences.en: Literally.
sentences.zh: 真的。

sentences.en: But I, I, I'm like a field marshal of sleep over here because once I put the kids to bed about, and these guys know, about 9, 9.30, I'm in bed.
sentences.zh: 但我——我——我简直就是这里的睡眠元帅，因为一旦我把孩子们哄睡着——大概在9点、9点半左右，这几个人都知道——我就上床睡觉了。

sentences.en: I read a little bit, old school, actual book.
sentences.zh: 我读一小会儿书，老派的那种，真正的纸质书。

sentences.en: I put my device away and I go to sleep and it's very important.
sentences.zh: 我把电子设备收起来，然后去睡觉，这非常重要。

sentences.en: My sleep is very, very important to me.
sentences.zh: 我的睡眠对我和我的健康来说真的非常非常重要。

sentences.en: And I get up super early.
sentences.zh: 而且我起得超级早。

sentences.en: So I don't sleep 9 till 9, but I'll sleep sort of 9.30 and I'll get up at 5.30 or 6 most days.
sentences.zh: 所以我不是从9点睡到9点，但我差不多9点半睡，大多数日子里我5点半或6点起床。

sentences.en: And I'm just saying that because I want to flex that I have better sleep hygiene than the Surgeon General.
sentences.zh: 我这么说只是为了炫耀我的睡眠卫生习惯比外科医生总监还要好。

sentences.en: And these are things you don't often get to do.
sentences.zh: 这些都是你平时不常有机会做的事情。

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不。

sentences.en: You totally do.
sentences.zh: 你完全可以。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: You totally do.
sentences.zh: 你完全可以。

sentences.en: And I, so that's an area I've got to work on.
sentences.zh: 而且我，所以这是我需要改进的一个方面。

sentences.en: Well, listen, and this is the reason I said it because what I'm going to say is I'd love to have the opportunity to come over and help you work through it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，听着，我之所以这么说是因为接下来我要说的是，我很乐意有机会过去帮你想办法解决它。

sentences.en: And I can talk you through it.
sentences.zh: 而且我可以跟你详细谈谈。

sentences.en: And I feel like I could be a real asset to you.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我可以成为你的一大帮手。

sentences.en: Yeah, there's nothing creepy about that.
sentences.zh: 对，这可一点都不令人毛骨悚然。

sentences.en: Just lay down next to him, read him a story.
sentences.zh: 就在他身旁躺下，给他读个故事。

sentences.en: I'm a sleep asset.
sentences.zh: 我是个睡眠助手。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: I was going to say, like, you know, the last thing I find is really powerful about sleep is actually, and this is a bit, it sounds like a bit of what Will does.
sentences.zh: 我本来想说的是，你知道的，我发现关于睡眠真正强大的最后一件事其实是，这有点听起来像是威尔会做的事。

sentences.en: It's like get yourself in the right place, like when you start sleeping.
sentences.zh: 就像是让自己处于正确的状态，比如当你开始睡觉的时候。

sentences.en: Because our minds are just like going a thousand miles an hour in a thousand directions, right?
sentences.zh: 因为我们的脑子里就像有一千迈的车速在朝一千个方向狂奔，对吧？

sentences.en: And like how to like quieten our mind and calm our mind before we.
sentences.zh: 以及如何像是在我们……之前让大脑静下来、平静下来。

sentences.en: And get on that runway.
sentences.zh: 然后走上那条跑道。

sentences.en: It's like getting on the right.
sentences.zh: 就像是踏上正确的……

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Listen, I've just had, I think you and I are just having the same idea at the same time.
sentences.zh: 听着，我刚……我觉得你和我只是在同一时间有了相同的想法。

sentences.en: Are you about to appoint me the sleep czar?
sentences.zh: 你这是打算任命我为睡眠沙皇吗？

sentences.en: That would be, we need a sleep czar, and it should be me.
sentences.zh: 那会……我们需要一个睡眠沙皇，而且那个人应该是我。

sentences.en: You've been putting people to sleep for years, Will.
sentences.zh: 你让人入睡已经很多年了，威尔。

sentences.en: This is perfect.
sentences.zh: 这太完美了。

sentences.en: It's unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 这简直难以置信。

sentences.en: We've got all, we've got the last season of Ozark queued up, and everybody will be out.
sentences.zh: 我们把《黑钱胜地》最后一季都排好队了，所有人都会睡着。

sentences.en: They'll be out.
sentences.zh: 他们绝对会睡着。

sentences.en: Believe me.
sentences.zh: 相信我。

sentences.en: Return to Ozark is the one that I'm doing.
sentences.zh: 回归《黑钱胜地》正是我在做的。

sentences.en: You guys are hysterical.
sentences.zh: 你们两个太搞笑了。

sentences.en: And we will be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。
