sentences.zh: 回到节目中。

sentences.en: I want to talk about climate change because look, I prefer to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈气候变化，因为你看，我更喜欢睡觉。

sentences.en: Stop looking out the window.
sentences.zh: 别再望着窗外了。

sentences.en: It's not happening like that.
sentences.zh: 情况不是那样的。

sentences.en: That's weather.
sentences.zh: 那是天气。

sentences.en: I just stare at the window.
sentences.zh: 我只是盯着窗户看。

sentences.en: I prefer cooler climates.
sentences.zh: 我更喜欢凉爽的气候。

sentences.en: I hate when it's hot.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌天气热的时候。

sentences.en: So I'm really angry about climate change.
sentences.zh: 所以我对气候变化真的非常生气。

sentences.en: But talk to me like, how does climate change and your position work together?
sentences.zh: 但跟我聊聊，气候变化和你的立场是如何结合在一起的？

sentences.en: What are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你们在做什么？

sentences.en: Is there any good news about freaking climate change?
sentences.zh: 关于该死的气候变化有什么好消息吗？

sentences.en: Are we doing anything to make it better?
sentences.zh: 我们有在做任何让它变好的事情吗？

sentences.en: Well, so the first question, my office actually does work on climate change.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以第一个问题，我的办公室实际上确实在处理气候变化问题。

sentences.en: We did actually work a lot before when I was Surgeon General.
sentences.zh: 事实上，以前我担任外科医生总监时，我们做了很多这方面的工作。

sentences.en: We actually had worked on an initiative with the NIH and with President Obama on climate change and health.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我们曾与美国国立卫生研究院以及奥巴马总统合作开展过一项关于气候变化与健康的倡议。

sentences.en: Because it turns out there are some pretty big impacts of climate change on health for a whole bunch of reasons we could talk about.
sentences.zh: 因为事实证明，由于我们可以讨论的诸多原因，气候变化对健康产生了一些相当大的影响。

sentences.en: And now going forward, actually, in the administration, we recently set up, you know, in the Department of Health and Human Services, an office of climate change and health equity.
sentences.zh: 而且现在展望未来，实际上，在政府内部，我们最近在卫生与公众服务部设立了一个气候变化与健康公平办公室。

sentences.en: And this is part of a much broader push on investing in, you know, and addressing climate change, not just domestically, but in terms of like global action that we're embarking on.
sentences.zh: 这是对气候变化进行投资和应对这一更广泛举措的一部分，不仅在国内，还包括我们正在着手的全球行动。

sentences.en: But look, it can't happen fast enough because these changes are happening in real time.
sentences.zh: 但听着，这还不够快，因为这些变化正在实时发生。

sentences.en: We're starting to like see them.
sentences.zh: 我们开始亲眼见证它们。

sentences.en: And sometimes people say, oh, like, you know, it seems like the temperature, global increase in temperature is really mild because they think like a degree or two.
sentences.zh: 有时人们会说，哦，你知道的，全球温度上升似乎真的很轻微，因为他们觉得只是一两度。

sentences.en: What's a big deal?
sentences.zh: 这有什么大不了的？

sentences.en: But the downstream consequences are really quite extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 但随之而来的连锁反应确实非常惊人。

sentences.en: So there is a lot of action and investment happening.
sentences.zh: 所以现在有大量的行动和投资正在进行。

sentences.en: The question is, are we going to be able to do enough?
sentences.zh: 问题是，我们能做到足够多吗？

sentences.en: Are we going to be able to sustain it?
sentences.zh: 我们能维持下去吗？

sentences.en: And if this is the kind of thing which, you know, our investment and our attention to it waxes and wanes, depending on who's in office at the time or the politics of the moment,
sentences.zh: 如果这种情况——你知道的，我们对它的投资和关注会随着当时在任的官员或当下的政治风向而起伏不定，

sentences.en: that's not going to serve us and our kids well.
sentences.zh: 那对我们和我们的孩子可没有什么好处。

sentences.en: And this is one of those things we've got to recognize.
sentences.zh: 这是我们必须认识到的事情之一。

sentences.en: It doesn't matter what your party is.
sentences.zh: 你的党派是什么并不重要。

sentences.en: This is a threat to all of us.
sentences.zh: 这对我们所有人都是一种威胁。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And so we've got to invest in addressing it just like we would any other health issue.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须像投资其他任何健康问题一样，投资于应对这一问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: No, we are, all sort of jokes aside, we are in an existential crisis right now.
sentences.zh: 不，抛开各种玩笑不谈，我们现在确实正处于一场生存危机中。

sentences.en: This, we, it is alarming where we're at.
sentences.zh: 我们所处的境地令人担忧。

sentences.en: And we don't talk a lot about stuff like this on this show, but we are in an alarming place right now on this planet.
sentences.zh: 我们在这个节目中不常谈论这种事情，但我们在这个星球上现在正处于一个令人担忧的境地。

sentences.en: And we are in a absolute climate emergency.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于绝对的气候紧急状态中。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Unless people come to terms with that and quickly, it's going to be over before we know it.
sentences.zh: 除非人们正视这一点，并且迅速行动，否则不知不觉中一切就都结束了。

sentences.en: And I know, again, I don't want to sound like a doomsday.
sentences.zh: 我知道，再说一次，我不想听起来像个世界末日论者。

sentences.en: Yeah, but it's one of those things, though, that like.
sentences.zh: 对，但这就是那种……

sentences.en: It's beyond urgent.
sentences.zh: 这已经不仅仅是紧急了。

sentences.en: So many things like, what can we do, right?
sentences.zh: 很多事情都在想，我们能做什么，对吧？

sentences.en: It seems that, yes, you can inform us that it's happening, but what can we do?
sentences.zh: 似乎是的，你可以通知我们这件事正在发生，但我们能做些什么呢？

sentences.en: Okay, so if we're in the fortunate position of buying a new car, we buy electric rather than gas.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果我们处于买新车的幸运位置，我们会买电动汽车而不是燃油车。

sentences.en: If we, you know, there are certain little things you can do, but for the most part, it's up to the government and the people to implement.
sentences.zh: 如果我们，你知道的，有一些你可以做的小事情，但大多数情况下，这取决于政府和人民去落实。

sentences.en: Jason, I know you're concerned because you were telling me the other day you were up all night.
sentences.zh: 杰森，我知道你很担心，因为你前几天告诉我你整晚没睡。

sentences.en: You went from room to room to room and you kept lighting light.
sentences.zh: 你挨个房间走来走去，不停地开着灯。

sentences.en: You would turn on the lights and you went to the guest house and you went to the other room.
sentences.zh: 你打开了灯，去了客房，又去了另一个房间。

sentences.en: And then you went to the other thing you're building.
sentences.zh: 然后你又去了你在建的另一个东西那儿。

sentences.en: You kept going from room to room and you got in the pool and it was warm.
sentences.zh: 你一直在各个房间里走来走去，然后你跳进游泳池，发现水是温的。

sentences.en: You got in the pool and you were just like trying to think, what can we, what can I do?
sentences.zh: 你泡在泳池里，脑子里只是在想，我们能……我能做些什么？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Yeah, go ahead.
sentences.zh: 行，你接着说。

sentences.en: Can I ask you guys a question, actually?
sentences.zh: 其实我能问你们一个问题吗？

sentences.en: You know, on this theme of just trying to rethink what life we want after this pandemic is over, I'm curious, when you guys think about your experience over the last 18 months,
sentences.zh: 你知道，围绕着重新思考这场大流行结束后我们想要什么生活这个主题，我很好奇，当你们回想过去18个月的经历时，

sentences.en: I'm curious, what was tough about it?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，有什么觉得艰难的吗？

sentences.en: But were there also things that were unexpected and good that you feel like, hey, I want to keep that in my life post-pandemic?
sentences.zh: 但有没有什么意料之外的美好事物，让你觉得，嘿，我想在后大流行时代把这留在我的生活中？

sentences.en: I don't want to go back to the way I was in 2019.
sentences.zh: 我不想回到2019年那种生活方式了。

sentences.en: Well, it was that quarantining with everybody, you know, being, having all that family time together was, was a, was a silver lining a bit.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就是和大家一起隔离，你知道的，拥有所有那些全家团聚的时光，算是一个一线希望吧。

sentences.en: I, I, I think, I hope many people experienced sort of that, that forced gathering we were all into.
sentences.zh: 我，我，我想，许多人都体验到了那种我们都身处其中的被迫相聚。

sentences.en: I, I, I really gained from that a lot.
sentences.zh: 我，我，我真的从中收获了很多。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: It was, it was incredible.
sentences.zh: 那真是，那真是难以置信。

sentences.en: It was, uh, in, you know, there were, obviously it was, it was, you know, so many lives were lost that, that, uh, that it's almost beyond comprehension, uh,
sentences.zh: 那，呃，在，你知道，有，显然那，那，你知道，有那么多生命消逝了，以至于，呃，几乎超出了理解的范畴，呃，

sentences.en: in such a short amount of time.
sentences.zh: 在如此短的时间内。

sentences.en: Uh, but, you know, for, for my immediate family, our, uh, it was a very, it was a time for us to come together.
sentences.zh: 呃，但是，你知道，对，对于我的核心家庭，我们的，呃，那是一个非常，对我们来说是一个团聚的时期。

sentences.en: There was a lot of, we actually had a lot of healing in our family in that time.
sentences.zh: 有很多，我们实际上在那段时间里让家庭得到了很多治愈。

sentences.en: Um, that was incredible, that otherwise, would not have otherwise happened.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那太不可思议了，否则的话，本来是不会发生的。

sentences.en: Um, and that I'm very, very, uh, thankful for it, if I'm being honeSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，说实话，对此我非常非常，呃，心怀感激。

sentences.en: Speaking of that, speaking of the terrible numbers of, of lives lost, do you, do you allow yourself to, to, a pat on the back is not the right term,
sentences.zh: 说到这个，说到那些逝去的惊人数字的生命，你，你是否允许自己，用“自我表扬”这个词可能不太对，

sentences.en: but do you realize how many lives you've saved by, by being, um, the man, um, in, in charge right now?
sentences.zh: 但你有没有意识到，通过担任，嗯，目前，嗯，负责任的那个人，你拯救了多少生命？

sentences.en: Uh, as far as rolling out this life-saving policies and some of the mandates, uh, more recently that have, that have come out.
sentences.zh: 呃，就推行这些挽救生命的政策以及最近出台的一些强制令而言。

sentences.en: I mean, look at how many lives have been saved from just the mandate of like, you can't smoke in certain places.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，看看仅仅通过诸如在某些地方不能吸烟这样的强制令，就挽救了多少生命。

sentences.en: Like that saves a lot of health problems with secondhand smoke, but this directly about the mandates of these vaccines, all these lives that are not being wasted, uh,
sentences.zh: 就像那样可以减少很多由于二手烟引起的健康问题，但这直接关系到这些疫苗的强制令，所有这些没有白白牺牲的生命，呃，

sentences.en: because of the courage of some of the policies that have been put forth.
sentences.zh: 正是因为所提出的一些政策的勇气。

sentences.en: But that, that, that's gotta feel, uh, uh, uh, good again is not probably the right word, but, uh, it's, uh, rewarding.
sentences.zh: 但那，那，那一定感觉，呃，呃，呃，“好”再次可能不是正确的词，但是，呃，它是，呃，有回报的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, sir, I do feel grateful, you know, to have, to have the chance to be involved in this kind of work because, because you're right.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，先生，我确实感到感激，你知道，能有机会参与这种工作，因为，因为你是对的。

sentences.en: I mean, this is one of those unusual circumstances in life where you can draw a very straight line between policies around vaccinating people and lives saved.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是生活中那种罕见的情况，你可以在围绕接种疫苗的政策与挽救的生命之间画出一条非常直接的线。

sentences.en: And we're seeing that now happen again and again and again.
sentences.zh: 而我们现在看到这种情况一次又一次地发生。

sentences.en: Um, but, you know, I'll tell you that, you know, this is actually one of the reasons why I took this job, you know, at the, after, uh, he was elected, um, you know, when,
sentences.zh: 嗯，但是，你知道，我告诉你，你知道，这实际上是我接受这份工作的原因之一，你知道，在，在，呃，他当选之后，嗯，你知道，当，

sentences.en: when the president and his team asked, you know, he need to come back and serve, uh, as surgeon general, it was not a hard decision.
sentences.zh: 当总统和他的团队邀请，你知道，他需要回来担任，呃，外科医生总长时，这不是一个艰难的决定。

sentences.en: And not just because I had been, you know, advising him, you know, over that, uh, that past year, but I remember talking to my wife about it.
sentences.zh: 不仅因为我一直，你知道，在过去的那一年里，一直在为他提供建议，而且我记得我和妻子谈过这件事。

sentences.en: And we said, you know, our kids are going to be studying this pandemic in school in five years, in 10 years, in 15 years.
sentences.zh: 我们说，你知道，我们的孩子在五年后、十年后、十五年后会在学校里学习这场大流行病。

sentences.en: Like people will be looking at this for generations to come and trying to glean lessons from it.
sentences.zh: 就像人们将在未来几代人中回顾这一点，并试图从中汲取教训一样。

sentences.en: Ask what went wrong, what went right.
sentences.zh: 询问什么地方做错了，什么地方做对了。

sentences.en: And at some point, our kids are going to ask us, like, mama.
sentences.zh: 然后在某个时候，我们的孩子会问我们，就像，妈妈。

sentences.en: You mean on Mars because this planet's uninhabited when they're on Mars?
sentences.zh: 你是说在火星上吗，因为当他们在火星时这个星球是无人居住的？

sentences.en: Well, you know, I think at some point our kids are going to ask us, like, mama, papa, what did you do?
sentences.zh: 好吧，你知道，我想在某个时候我们的孩子会问我们，就像，妈妈，爸爸，你们做了什么？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对吧。

sentences.en: You lived through it.
sentences.zh: 你们经历过它。

sentences.en: What did you do?
sentences.zh: 你们做了什么？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对吧。

sentences.en: And I want us to be able to tell them that we did absolutely everything that we could at a time where this pandemic was ravaging our country and the world,
sentences.zh: 我希望我们能够告诉他们，在大流行病蹂躏我们国家和世界的时期，我们绝对尽了我们所能去做了，

sentences.en: where we and our family had lost 10 members of our family to this disease and had seen many others hospitalized.
sentences.zh: 当时我们和我们的家人因为这种疾病失去了10位亲人，并看到许多其他人住院。

sentences.en: Like we wanted to be able to tell them, look, you know what?
sentences.zh: 就像我们想告诉他们，看，你知道吗？

sentences.en: We did everything we could, that we didn't sit home and say, you know what?
sentences.zh: 我们尽了我们所能，我们没有坐在家里说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: You know, it'd be a lot harder to like go into government.
sentences.zh: 你知道，进入政府会困难得多。

sentences.en: We have a much easier life, you know, here, you know, in the private sector.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们在私营部门的生活要轻松得多。

sentences.en: We didn't want to give excuses.
sentences.zh: 我们不想找借口。

sentences.en: We wanted to say that, you know what?
sentences.zh: 我们想说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: We ran toward the fire here.
sentences.zh: 我们这里是迎着火海冲上去的。

sentences.en: And so there's still a lot of work to do.
sentences.zh: 所以还有很多工作要做。

sentences.en: Well, I think there was a lot of people, though, like you, like speaking, Sean, you ran towards the fire.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不过我认为有很多人，像你一样，说真的，肖恩，你也是迎着火海冲上去的。

sentences.en: By the way, if the fire is the chin chin on sunset, you ran right towards it.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，如果火灾是指日落大道的 Chin Chin 餐馆，你就是直接朝它冲过去。

sentences.en: I wish that was the approach with climate, sort of addressing the immediacy of it, because I feel like if people lived traditionally to be 150 years old instead of, say,
sentences.zh: 我希望对待气候问题也能采取这种态度，某种程度上解决它的紧迫性，因为我觉得如果人们传统上能活到 150 岁而不是，比方说，

sentences.en: 90 years old, then maybe we would enact more sort of strict policies because we would actually be alive enough to reap the benefits of it.
sentences.zh: 90 岁，那么也许我们会颁布更多类似严格的政策，因为我们实际上能活得足够久来收获它的好处。

sentences.en: Or the lack of implementing those policies, we would be exposed to the consequences of not acting.
sentences.zh: 或者说不实施这些政策的话，我们就会暴露在不作为的后果之中。

sentences.en: In other words, the cynic in me says that the politicians are not putting forth really good policies because they all figure, well,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，我心中的愤世嫉俗者认为，政客们没有提出真正好的政策，因为他们都盘算着，嗯，

sentences.en: we're going to be dead before this planet roasts.
sentences.zh: 在这个星球烤焦之前我们都已经死光了。

sentences.en: And they're not thinking about their kids.
sentences.zh: 而且他们没有为他们的孩子着想。

sentences.en: And they should be because it really is going to – things are going to come home to roost after we're all gone.
sentences.zh: 他们本该为之着想的，因为这确实会——在我们所有人都离去之后，事情终究会产生恶果。

sentences.en: We should be thinking about that, right?
sentences.zh: 我们应该考虑这一点，对吧？

sentences.en: We should be.
sentences.zh: 我们确实应该。

sentences.en: And, look, if you ask me what do we need to truly accelerate our work on climate change, I would tell you that we need political courage.
sentences.zh: 而且，听着，如果你问我，为了真正加速我们在气候变化方面的工作，我们需要什么，我会告诉你，我们需要政治勇气。

sentences.en: We need accurate information to be shared with people, not rampant misinformation that you see on social media right now.
sentences.zh: 我们需要与人们分享准确的信息，而不是你在社交媒体上看到的那些猖獗的虚假信息。

sentences.en: And the third thing we need is true grassroots mobilization.
sentences.zh: 我们需要的第三件事是真正的基层动员。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Those are the three things we need in our country and around the world to really address climate change.
sentences.zh: 这些是我们国家和世界各地真正应对气候变化所需要的三件事。

sentences.en: Because you're right.
sentences.zh: 因为你说得对。

sentences.en: It's not just about us, right?
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅关乎我们，对吧？

sentences.en: It's, you know, it's about our kids.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这关乎我们的孩子。

sentences.en: It's about future generations.
sentences.zh: 这关乎子孙后代。

sentences.en: It's like, you know, do we really feel that it's okay to say that, yeah, we're not sure that our grandkids will be able to live in a world that's truly hospitable,
sentences.zh: 这就好像是，你知道的，我们真的觉得这样说没问题吗？是的，我们不确定我们的孙辈是否能生活在一个真正适宜居住的世界里，

sentences.en: that they're not going to be able to enjoy the things that we enjoy?
sentences.zh: 他们将无法享受我们所享受的东西？

sentences.en: Like, that does not compute, I think, for people across the political spectrum.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，对于各个政治谱系的人来说，这都是无法理解的。

sentences.en: Yet, if you look at the way that this has been politicized, this issue, if you look also at the way that misinformation has spread rampantly about it,
sentences.zh: 然而，如果你看看这个问题被政治化的方式，如果你也看看关于它的虚假信息猖獗传播的方式，

sentences.en: despite how much scientific consensus there is on climate change, you realize there's a disservice being done.
sentences.zh: 尽管科学界对气候变化有着高度共识，你会意识到这是一种伤害。

sentences.en: And, look, I got to say, you know, on this point about the misinformation, we talked about social media earlier, you know, but early in the summer, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，听着，我必须说，你知道的，关于虚假信息的这一点，我们之前讨论过社交媒体，你知道的，但在夏天刚开始的时候，你知道的，

sentences.en: I issued a Surgeon General's advisory on the harms of health misinformation, just recognizing that, not just with COVID, but more broadly.
sentences.zh: 我发布了一份美国外科医师总长关于健康虚假信息危害的咨询报告，认识到这一点不仅适用于新冠肺炎，而且具有更广泛的意义。

sentences.en: It was awesome.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: I remember that.
sentences.zh: 我记得那个。

sentences.en: It was fantastic.
sentences.zh: 好极了。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢。

sentences.en: But, you know, one of the things that was frustrating me is that, you know, misinformation is not new.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，让我感到沮丧的事情之一是，你知道的，虚假信息并不是什么新鲜事。

sentences.en: It's really made now so different from the paSt.
sentences.zh: 现在的状况与过去大不相同。

sentences.en: And what I've always said to the platforms and continue to say publicly and privately is it is not okay from a moral standpoint for them to allow the rampant spread of this misinformation,
sentences.zh: 我一直对各大平台说，并且在公开和私下里也一直在说的是，从道德立场来看，他们允许这种虚假信息猖獗传播，

sentences.en: knowing it's causing harm and knowing it's dividing us further, and to just sit back and not do enough about it or to tinker around the edges and say, you know what,
sentences.zh: 明知这正在造成危害，明知这正在进一步分裂我们，却只是坐视不管、做得远远不够，或者只是在边缘小修小补，然后说，你知道吗，

sentences.en: we're trying to address it.
sentences.zh: 我们正在努力解决它。

sentences.en: Or, hey, look over here at all the good things that we're doing.
sentences.zh: 或者，嘿，看看我们正在做的所有这些好事。

sentences.en: It's like, imagine if I ran a hospital, right, and I was treating people, like, pretty well for, like, heart attacks and pneumonias and stuff,
sentences.zh: 这就好比，想象一下如果我经营一家医院，对吧，我把人们治疗得挺好，比如心脏病发作、肺炎之类的，

sentences.en: but I had a really high rate of line infections and surgical site infections and blood clots because I just wasn't cleaning my procedures and I wasn't taking the precautions I need.
sentences.zh: 但我有很高的导管感染率、手术部位感染率和血栓发生率，因为我只是没有规范操作程序，也没有采取我需要的防范措施。

sentences.en: Would anybody say, you know what, that's okay.
sentences.zh: 会有人说，你知道吗，这没关系。

sentences.en: We'll forget about all those safety issues because, you know, you're treating.
sentences.zh: 我们会忘掉所有这些安全问题，因为，你知道的，你在治病。

sentences.en: We would say, no, you got to do the right thing and you got to do it safely.
sentences.zh: 我们会说，不，你必须做正确的事，而且你必须安全地做这件事。

sentences.en: And the same moral standard should apply to these platforMs.
sentences.zh: 同样的道德标准也应该适用于这些平台。

sentences.en: There's a very clear health risk and health damage with the misinformation.
sentences.zh: 虚假信息存在非常明确的健康风险和健康危害。

sentences.en: So why not make that as illegal as driving too fast or driving without a seatbelt or smoking in a bar?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么不把它弄得像超速驾驶、不系安全带或在酒吧吸烟一样违法呢？

sentences.en: I agree.
sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.en: It should be against the law because it's creating health harm.
sentences.zh: 它应该违法，因为它会造成健康危害。

sentences.en: What's tough for you is you have to find different ways to try to sell the American public on doing things that are good for them and encouraging them to do it.
sentences.zh: 对你来说艰难的是，你必须找到不同的方法，试图说服美国公众去做对他们有益的事情，并鼓励他们去做。

sentences.en: But there is a culture in this country of doing things that are against the public interest by other groups.
sentences.zh: 但是这个国家存在一种文化，其他群体在做违背公众利益的事情。

sentences.en: And it's so insane.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: By just being contrarians.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是为了唱反调。

sentences.en: It's insane.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: It's insane that nobody does anything about it.
sentences.zh: 没有人对此采取任何行动，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: There's no controversy when it comes to the environment.
sentences.zh: 在环境问题上没有任何争议。

sentences.en: There's no debate to be had.
sentences.zh: 没有什么好辩论的。

sentences.en: They say, well, there are these other – no, there's no debate on it.
sentences.zh: 他们说，嗯，还有这些——不，对此没有任何辩论。

sentences.en: There's no debate when it comes to the virus.
sentences.zh: 在病毒问题上没有任何辩论。

sentences.en: Because it's real.
sentences.zh: 因为它是真实的。

sentences.en: The fact that we've allowed these things to occur is absurd.
sentences.zh: 我们容许这些事情发生，这本身就很荒谬。

sentences.en: Well, look, you know, it is frustrating because I'll tell you as a doctor even long before I was in government,
sentences.zh: 嗯，听着，你知道的，这确实让人沮丧，因为我跟你说，作为一个医生，甚至早在进入政府之前，

sentences.en: the most frustrating moments are when you have somebody who's sick and you know what they need.
sentences.zh: 最让人沮丧的时刻就是你遇到了生病的患者，而你明明知道他们需要什么。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But you can't get it to them.
sentences.zh: 但你却没办法把药给他们。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Those are the most frustrating moments.
sentences.zh: 那些才是最令人沮丧的时刻。

sentences.en: Those are even more frustrating than the moments where we don't have a cure for something.
sentences.zh: 这些甚至比那些我们对某种病束手无策的时刻还要让人沮丧。

sentences.en: It's like you have the cure.
sentences.zh: 这就好比你明明有了疗法。

sentences.en: You have the preventive tool.
sentences.zh: 你拥有预防的工具。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But you can't actually get it for somebody because the misinformation is some other reason.
sentences.zh: 但你却无法真正为某人争取到它，因为虚假信息或其他原因。

sentences.en: They don't take the vaccine, but then when they get sick, they do come to you at the hospital to get fixed.
sentences.zh: 他们不接种疫苗，但当他们生病时，他们确实会来医院找你治病。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I mean, but I think there are a lot of people, though, who have been misled, you know, in our country.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，不过我认为在我们国家，有很多人其实是被误导了，你知道的。

sentences.en: And this is why I don't entirely, like, fault, you know, folks themselves for some of these decisions.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我并不完全，比如说，去责怪老百姓自己做出其中的某些决定。

sentences.en: Because if you are consuming a huge amount of misinformation in an echo chamber and are being essentially led to believe that that's all accurate,
sentences.zh: 因为如果你在一个回音室里大量接触虚假信息，并且基本上被引导去相信这些都是准确的，

sentences.en: that's coming from trusted sources, then, you know, why wouldn't you think that some of these, that COVID's not real, that the vaccine's not good for you or something,
sentences.zh: 这些都是来自可靠的来源，那么，你知道的，你为什么不认为其中一些，比如新冠不是真的，疫苗对你不好之类的，

sentences.en: or some of these other fallacies.
sentences.zh: 或者诸如此类的其他谬论呢。

sentences.en: So, this is why I think also that we have to, if we don't do something about the information environment in which we're operating.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是为什么我认为，如果我们不采取措施改善我们所处的这个信息环境的话。

sentences.en: And the misinformation.
sentences.zh: 还有虚假信息。

sentences.en: It's not even just COVID.
sentences.zh: 甚至不仅仅是新冠。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是的。

sentences.en: Everything else.
sentences.zh: 还有其他所有事情。

sentences.en: It's climate change.
sentences.zh: 比如气候变化。

sentences.en: It's like health reform.
sentences.zh: 比如医疗改革。

sentences.en: Everything becomes hard.
sentences.zh: 每件事都变得艰难。

sentences.en: And is that something that you can drive from your office, that sort of that policy initiative to sort of try to not regulate the internet?
sentences.zh: 那么，这是否是你可以从你的办公室去推动的事情，那种试图不监管互联网的政策倡议？

sentences.en: Well, you were saying that you can suggest things, but there's nothing that you can actually, you can't mandate it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你刚才说你可以提出建议，但实际上没有什么事是你能够，你无法强制执行的。

sentences.en: I think that these are things that have to come from a lot of different places and there needs to be a consensus, right?
sentences.zh: 我认为这些事情必须来自许多不同的地方，并且需要达成共识，对吧？

sentences.en: Am I right?
sentences.zh: 我说的对吗？

sentences.en: Well, so, you see, yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，你看，是的。

sentences.en: So, what we can do is, like, we can certainly draw attention to and draw, like, national strategies for this, work together with the legislature, which, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，我们能做的是，比如说，我们当然可以引起人们的注意并制定国家层面的战略，与立法机关合作，你知道的，

sentences.en: creates laws and regulations, and work with other branches of government to use levers to push, you know, folks to do the right thing.
sentences.zh: 立法机关负责制定法律和法规，并与其他政府部门合作，利用各种杠杆来推动，你知道的，人们做正确的事。

sentences.en: But, ultimately, I'll tell you, government, this is not a problem government alone can solve because in people, it's when they speak up with their voices and say, look,
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，我得告诉你，政府，这不是单靠政府就能解决的问题，因为对于民众来说，当他们发出自己的声音说，听着，

sentences.en: we're not tolerating this anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们再也不会容忍这一切了。

sentences.en: We don't want to use a platform that's not curbing, you know, harmful information that our kids are being exposed to and others are exposed to.
sentences.zh: 我们不想使用一个不去遏制那些我们的孩子以及其他人正在接触的有害信息的平台。

sentences.en: Like, it's only when people vote with their feet, ultimately, that you can have, like, the biggest effect.
sentences.zh: 比如，归根结底，只有当人们用脚投票时，你才能产生最大的影响。

sentences.en: So, it's not to say government shouldn't do something and can't make an impact, but I'm just saying that, you know, for a lot of these companies,
sentences.zh: 所以，这并不是说政府不应该做些什么、也无法产生影响，我只是说，你知道的，对于许多这样的大公司来说，

sentences.en: it's when their users start leaving that they worry, right?
sentences.zh: 只有当他们的用户开始流失时，他们才会感到担忧，对吧？

sentences.en: It's when their advertisers start leaving that they worry.
sentences.zh: 只有当他们的广告商开始离开时，他们才会感到担忧。

sentences.en: And what I think is that this goes, the laws of, as I think of it, like morality and humanity are more important than any other law, right?
sentences.zh: 而我认为，这超越了法律，在我看来，道德和人性的法则比任何其他法律都更重要，对吧？

sentences.en: And we have a moral responsibility to take care of one another, not harm one another, to do the right thing, not because we're obligated to by law,
sentences.zh: 我们有道德责任去照顾彼此，不去互相伤害，去做正确的事，不是因为法律要求我们这么做，

sentences.en: but because it's the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 而是因为这是正确的事。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢这个了。

sentences.en: And that's the cultural difference in this country.
sentences.zh: 这就是这个国家的文化差异。

sentences.en: That does not exist enough in this country that I love a lot, and I've never said that in public, that I really do love living in this country, and I've lived here for many years.
sentences.zh: 在我非常喜爱的这个国家里，这种精神还不够普及，我以前从未在公开场合说过我真的很喜欢住在这个国家，而且我已经在这里住了很多年了。

sentences.en: It doesn't exist enough.
sentences.zh: 这还远远不够。

sentences.en: And it's, you're only as strong as your weakest link, and people don't seem to understand that.
sentences.zh: 而且，你的实力取决于你最薄弱的环节，人们似乎并不明白这一点。

sentences.en: They can't get a grasp on it.
sentences.zh: 他们无法理解这一点。

sentences.en: And then there's too much of, like, yeah, but I need to get mine.
sentences.zh: 然后会有太多那种，“对，但我得顾好我自己。”

sentences.en: And I know that that's at the heart of how this country was founded.
sentences.zh: 而且我知道，这正是这个国家建国理念的核心所在。

sentences.en: It was about sort of exploring whatever, no ceiling to whatever success you could have economically, et cetera, et cetera, et cetera, and that nobody was going to hold you back.
sentences.zh: 这关乎去探索各种可能，你的经济成就等等之类的一切都是没有上限的，而且没有人会阻挠你。

sentences.en: But you have to understand that we are going to sink unless everybody starts bailing at the same rate.
sentences.zh: 但你必须明白，除非每个人都以同样的力度开始排水，否则我们都会沉没。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Here's the reason I feel optimistic about this, Will, though, is that I actually think that the majority of people in our country share the sentiment,
sentences.zh: 威尔，我之所以对此感到乐观的原因是，我其实觉得我们国家大多数人都有着这样的共鸣，

sentences.en: that they want to do the right thing, that they have a sense of obligation to one another.
sentences.zh: 他们想做正确的事，他们对彼此有着责任感。

sentences.en: And then when push comes to shove, they actually reach for a better spirit, for, you know, a better cause.
sentences.zh: 当关键时刻来临，他们实际上会展现出更好的精神面貌，为了，你知道的，一个更崇高的事业。

sentences.en: They seek to serve and help one another.
sentences.zh: 他们努力去服务和帮助彼此。

sentences.en: Because you see that play out in communities day in, day out.
sentences.zh: 因为你在社区里日复一日地看到这种情景上演。

sentences.en: You saw that a lot during COVID.
sentences.zh: 你在疫情期间经常能看到这一点。

sentences.en: But I think what happens is that there's a very vocal minority.
sentences.zh: 但我认为发生的情况是，存在着一个声音很大的少数群体。

sentences.en: There are people who, I think, manipulate folks, you know, for gain in one way or another.
sentences.zh: 有些人，我认为，为了这样或那样的利益，在操纵民众。

sentences.en: And it distorts things.
sentences.zh: 这扭曲了事实。

sentences.en: It leads us to believe that we're a country that's more deeply divided than we actually are, whereas there's a large, silent majority of people in our country who, I think,
sentences.zh: 它让我们以为我们是一个比实际情况分裂得更严重的国家，然而在我们国家，有一个庞大的、沉默的大多数，我认为，

sentences.en: care deeply, want to do the right thing, want us all to get through this together.
sentences.zh: 他们深切关怀，想做正确的事，希望我们所有人能一起度过难关。

sentences.en: I believe that.
sentences.zh: 我相信这一点。

sentences.en: So that's why I think these changes, cultural changes, ultimately are the most powerful forces that drive policy change, you know, in the long term.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是为什么我认为这些改变，文化上的改变，最终是从长远来看推动政策改变的最强大力量。

sentences.en: And that cultural resurgence, you know, of care, compassion, kindness, and love, that has to come from a grassroots level.
sentences.zh: 而这种关怀、同情、善良和爱的文化复兴，必须从基层开始。

sentences.en: That's why I, you know, sometimes people ask me, like, Surgeon General, why do you, like, talk about love so much?
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我，你知道的，有时人们会问我，比如，医疗总监，你为什么，比如，这么经常谈论爱？

sentences.en: I talk about love because it's the most powerful medicine that we have.
sentences.zh: 我谈论爱，是因为它是我们拥有的最强大的药剂。

sentences.en: It's a force that we need now more than ever.
sentences.zh: 它是我们现在比以往任何时候都更需要的一股力量。

sentences.en: Also, it's all exacerbated by the fact that we can't see each other or interact with each other and be connected.
sentences.zh: 此外，这一切都被这样一个事实加剧了：我们无法互相看到、互相交流和建立联系。

sentences.en: And once we, once you actually see somebody and connect them and listen to them and hear them, I think everything you're saying is true.
sentences.zh: 一旦我们，一旦你真正看到某人并与他们建立联系、倾听他们、听到他们的心声，我认为你所说的一切都是真的。

sentences.en: It makes it more valuable when you can connect and even touch somebody, hug somebody, talk to somebody, listen to somebody.
sentences.zh: 当你能与人建立联系，甚至触摸某人、拥抱某人、与某人交谈、倾听某人时，这就更有价值了。

sentences.en: It all helps, to your point.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，这一切都有帮助。

sentences.en: And you've been very constant and consistent, Mr. Surgeon General, in being that comforting, non-emotional,
sentences.zh: 医疗总监先生，你一直非常坚定和一致地成为我们国家在这个艰难时期中那个令人慰藉的、没有情绪化的、

sentences.en: non-political sort of center of common sense in our country with this tough, tough time.
sentences.zh: 没有政治色彩的常识中心。

sentences.en: And so thank you for that.
sentences.zh: 所以非常感谢你。

sentences.en: And please continue.
sentences.zh: 请继续。

sentences.en: And I love that you keep going back onto falling back onto, you know, using love is, I think you're, I think that's awesome.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢你一直回归到，你知道的，使用“爱”这个概念，我觉得你，我觉得这太棒了。

sentences.en: I think it's a great position to have.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个很好的立场。

sentences.en: I think that's, it was the great Joe Elliott of the band, Def Leppard, who said, pour some sugar on me.
sentences.zh: 我想那是，威豹乐队（Def Leppard）伟大的乔·埃利奥特（Joe Elliott）说过的那句，给我撒点糖。

sentences.en: I love that song.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那首歌。

sentences.en: Oh, God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Dr. Murthy, thank you so much for your time today.
sentences.zh: 默西医生，非常感谢你今天抽出时间。

sentences.en: We so appreciate you and everything you've done, everything you continue to do to make us safer, to make the world safer.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感谢你以及你所做的一切，你为让我们更安全、让世界更安全所持续做的一切。

sentences.en: Much love to you and much appreciated.
sentences.zh: 向你致以满满的爱意，深表感激。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Hey, at the risk of taking us long, let me just say one last thing on that point we just raised.
sentences.zh: 嘿，冒着让我们谈话变长的风险，关于我们刚才提出的那个观点，让我再说最后一点。

sentences.en: About Def Leppard?
sentences.zh: 关于威豹乐队？

sentences.en: This is so important.
sentences.zh: 这非常重要。

sentences.en: Is it about Def Leppard?
sentences.zh: 是关于威豹乐队的吗？

sentences.en: Not about Def Leppard, although that was my sixth grade prom dance song.
sentences.zh: 不是关于威豹乐队的，虽然那是我的六年级毕业舞会舞曲。

sentences.en: Sure, remember, pour some sugar on me.
sentences.zh: 当然，记得吗，“给我撒点糖”。

sentences.en: No, but just to say this, this point about love, this is, this to me is a defining question of our time right now, is do, fundamentally,
sentences.zh: 不，但只是想说，关于爱的这个观点，这对我来说是我们这个时代一个决定性的问题，那就是，从根本上讲，

sentences.en: I believe that there are two forces ultimately that drive us in our decision making.
sentences.zh: 我相信最终有两种力量在驱动我们的决策。

sentences.en: There's love and there's fear, and they have different manifestations, right?
sentences.zh: 一种是爱，一种是恐惧，它们有不同的表现形式，对吧？

sentences.en: Fear can show up as anger, as insecurity, as jealousy, as rage, you know.
sentences.zh: 恐惧可以表现为愤怒、不安全感、嫉妒、狂怒，你知道的。

sentences.en: Yeah, to me it's the empire and the rebellion from Star Wars, but keep going.
sentences.zh: 对，对我来说，这就像《星球大战》里的帝国与叛军，不过你接着说。

sentences.en: Right, but love can also show up as kindness and generosity and empathy.
sentences.zh: 没错，但爱也可以表现为善良、慷慨和同理心。

sentences.en: And in every moment in our life when we're making decisions, whether it's about how we treat a stranger,
sentences.zh: 而且在我们生活中做出决定的每一个时刻，无论是关于我们如何对待陌生人，

sentences.en: how we treat the person next to us that we know and our neighbor or our family, we have this choice.
sentences.zh: 我们如何对待身边的熟人、邻居或家人，我们都有这种选择。

sentences.en: You know, how we react to the news, whether we choose to turn on the TV or turn off the TV.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们对新闻的反应，无论是选择打开电视还是关掉电视。

sentences.en: We have a choice to make.
sentences.zh: 我们都有一个抉择要做。

sentences.en: And what strikes me is that because we each have a choice, we each have power, right?
sentences.zh: 而让我触动的是，正因为我们每个人都有选择，所以我们每个人都有力量，对吧？

sentences.en: And so if we are looking to build a culture that is rooted in love and not fear,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果我们想要建立一种根植于爱而非恐惧的文化，

sentences.en: that is a choice we have to ask ourselves how to make each day in the small decisions and in the big decisions.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们必须问自己的抉择：如何在每一天的小决定和宏大决策中去实现它。

sentences.en: And I started thinking about this five and a half years ago when we found out that we were pregnant with our first child.
sentences.zh: 五年前半前，当我们得知我们的第一个孩子即将出世时，我开始思考这个问题。

sentences.en: And I still remember coming home and my wife was sitting at the dining room chair, just actually just a few feet away from here.
sentences.zh: 我还记得我回到家，我妻子坐在餐椅上，其实离这里只有几英尺远。

sentences.en: And she just looked really happy.
sentences.zh: 她看起来非常高兴。

sentences.en: I was like, what's going on?
sentences.zh: 我说，怎么了？

sentences.en: And she showed me the pregnancy test indicator, which was positive.
sentences.zh: 她把验孕棒给我看，上面显示是阳性。

sentences.en: And we were just so thrilled and so excited to be parents.
sentences.zh: 我们当时欣喜若狂，为即将成为父母而激动不已。

sentences.en: But I remember sitting down on the bed next to her and just pausing for a moment, letting it sink in.
sentences.zh: 但我也记得坐在她身边的床沿上，静静地停顿了一会儿，让这个消息沉淀下来。

sentences.en: And there was a part of me which got anxious and was like, oh, my God, like, what kind of world are we bringing our child into?
sentences.zh: 我内心深处有一部分开始感到焦虑，心想，天哪，我们究竟把我们的孩子带到一个什么样的世界里？

sentences.en: Like, is this going to be a world where people, you know, help our child up when he falls down?
sentences.zh: 这会是一个当我们的孩子摔倒时，别人会伸手拉他一把的世界吗？

sentences.en: Or is this going to be a hostile, you know, sort of fearful, angry world?
sentences.zh: 还是会变成一个充满敌意、某种程度上令人恐惧和愤怒的世界？

sentences.en: And it was in that moment that it really solidified within me that as a parent, like,
sentences.zh: 正是在那个时刻，我的内心变得无比坚定：作为一个父母，

sentences.en: my responsibility now was to make sure that the world for my child and for other children was more likely to be grounded in love rather than fear.
sentences.zh: 我现在的责任是确保我的孩子和其他孩子的世界，更有可能建立在爱而不是恐惧的基础之上。

sentences.en: And that had to be done through the choices that I made in my life in whatever sphere, my personal life, my work life, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 这必须通过我在生活的各个领域所做出的选择来完成，无论是在我的个人生活中、工作生活中，还是其他方面。

sentences.en: And that's why it can,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么它可以在……

sentences.en: in a time when so many people feel disempowered and feel like the problems that we're facing are so big and too big for them to make a difference in on their own.
sentences.zh: 在这样一个时代：许多人感到自己无能为力，觉得我们所面临的问题如此庞大，单凭他们自己根本无法产生影响。

sentences.en: I just want us to never forget that we have the power to choose between love and fear.
sentences.zh: 我只是想让我们永远不要忘记，我们在爱与恐惧之间拥有选择的力量。

sentences.en: And the ripple effects that we have on other people when we do that directly,
sentences.zh: 当我们这样做时，它对其他人产生的直接涟漪效应，

sentences.en: the example we set indirectly for those who may not say anything to us but are impacted by our example, that is powerful.
sentences.zh: 以及我们为那些可能对我们一言不发、却深受我们榜样影响的人间接树立的榜样，这是充满力量的。

sentences.en: That is how culture changes.
sentences.zh: 文化就是这样改变的。

sentences.en: That's how our country will change.
sentences.zh: 我们的国家也将因此改变。

sentences.en: Which, that's how we will become better and create a better world for our kids as well.
sentences.zh: 这也正是我们将变得更好，并为我们的孩子创造一个更好世界的途径。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Amen.
sentences.zh: 说得好。

sentences.en: That's so great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: That's fantastic.
sentences.zh: 真是太精彩了。

sentences.en: What a wonderful.
sentences.zh: 多么美妙啊。

sentences.en: Thank you for, thank you for that.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，谢谢你分享这些。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: Thank you, Dr. Murthy.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，默西医生。

sentences.en: That's fantastic.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: I mean, by the way, that's, we should just air that everywhere.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这个，我们真该把它在各地播放。

sentences.en: Everything you just said.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说的一切。

sentences.en: That'll be our little teaser.
sentences.zh: 这将成为我们的小预告片。

sentences.en: Take that clip.
sentences.zh: 剪下这段视频。

sentences.en: Yeah, it'll be our little teaser.
sentences.zh: 对，这将是我们的一个小预告片。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being here.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你能来到这里。

sentences.en: Thank you for giving us some new Saturday.
sentences.zh: 感谢你在某个周六抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thank you for your time.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你宝贵的时间。

sentences.en: Thank you for your service.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你所做出的贡献。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, thank you all so much.
sentences.zh: 好，非常感谢大家。

sentences.en: I really enjoyed talking to you.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢和你聊天。

sentences.en: And I got to say, even when I still had the little cover over my lens,
sentences.zh: 而且我必须得说，甚至在我镜头上的小盖子还没摘下来的时候，

sentences.en: just hearing the love and brotherhood between you guys and the good humor was,
sentences.zh: 仅仅听到你们之间那种爱、兄弟情谊以及幽默感，

sentences.en: it made me feel good.
sentences.zh: 就让我感觉很好。

sentences.en: So, and Jason, I got to tell you before you leave that couples retreat,
sentences.zh: 所以，杰森，在你离开之前我得告诉你，那个双人情侣静修营，

sentences.en: watched that movie so many times, loved it.
sentences.zh: 那部电影我看了好多遍，非常喜欢。

sentences.en: It was hysterical, kept me laughing.
sentences.zh: 太爆笑了，把我逗得一直笑。

sentences.en: So thank you for that.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你带给我们这些。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Yeah, that was fun to do.
sentences.zh: 对，拍那个挺好玩的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好啦。

sentences.en: Well, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 嗯，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Enjoy the rest of your weekend and we'll see you on the TV.
sentences.zh: 祝你周末剩余时间过得愉快，我们在电视上见。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好啦。

sentences.en: Bye-bye, guys.
sentences.zh: 再见，伙计们。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。
